title: When a pull request counts as stalled
content: A pull request is stalled once it has had no review activity — no review, no comment, no push — for longer than the staleness threshold recorded on this workflow's installation (one working day unless changed). The clock counts working days only: weekends and the reviewer's out-of-office windows never age a pull request. Draft pull requests and ones labelled as parked are never stalled, however old.

title: Nudges are direct, digests are public
content: A nudge about one person's outstanding review is sent to that person directly. The team channel receives only the daily digest, which names pull requests and their blockers but never singles out an individual as late. Public pressure about review latency is a team-health problem, not a throughput fix.
